verdict.rationale: Square provides extensive documented public APIs (Payments, Refunds, Disputes, Payouts, Invoices, Subscriptions, Webhooks) plus official SDKs (Node.js) with idempotency and sandbox testing support, and even an llms.txt for AI discoverability and a documented MCP server. missing for 10: no discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (404s on probes), no independent hands-on report confirming full API completeness.
